newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Berisha says not resigning - Albanian television.
newsitem.headline: Berisha says not resigning - Albanian television.

text.p: Albanian President Sali Berisha said on Saturday he had no intention of resigning, state television reported.
A statement read on the main evening news quoted Berisha as saying he would move forward with a programme to hold elections under an all-party government appointed last week.

Rumours had earlier circulated through Tirana that Berisha had resigned. Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo, speaking at a meeting of European Union ministers in the Netherlands, announced he had heard reports Berisha had quit.

Berisha's statement was issued after tension and random shooting had subsided amid an enhanced police presence in Tirana. It said the president intended to press on with an agreement signed last week with 10 political parties to stage early elections and repeated his pledge to step down if parties backing him lost.
"Any attempt to deviate from this agreement will create division and have unforeseen consequences in deepening existing destabilisation," it said.
"I think it is not by bowing to the wishes of armed groups but rather by carrying out the proposed agreement that stability will be legitimately restored in the country."
